question:
**Direction: Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a spelling error. Select the option that rectifies the error.**

The Magdeburg water bridge is the longest navigable aquaduct built over the river Elbe in Germany.
solution:
The correct answer is **"aqueduct."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is "aquaduct."
 
• The correct spelling is **"****aqueduct."**
 
• "Aqueduct" means a structure like a bridge for carrying water across a valley or low ground. (पुल जैसा ढाँचा जिसके द्वारा पानी को घाटी के पार अथवा निम्न सतह तक ले जाया जाता है; कृत्रिम जल-प्रणाल; जलसेतु)
 
 
• Example: *Water-control features included **aqueducts**__, drains, walled channels, dams, and a bridge.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Correct sentence**: * The Magdeburg water bridge is the longest navigable __**aqueduct**__ built over the river Elbe in Germany. *
